body: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.
summaryZh: 为了解决视觉语言模型中图像Token计算量大的问题，本文引入了Varest压缩框架。该方法基于语义可替代性原则，通过变量分辨率合并保留物体边界和文字等细节，并利用学习到的相关寄存器在早期解码器处理后裁剪冗余视觉Token，在极低Token数量下保持了出色的模型性能。
